Release notes


# Weekly Dispatch: April 28, 2025


April 27, 2025


‍
‍ **⚙️ Dispatch**


- Add additional pickup time buffer by a configureable duration
- When dispatch fials, a specific failure reason is displayed in the portal
- Auto-reassignment upon cancellation is now conditional and will not be triggered based on specific cancellation reasons.


‍


‍📱 **Engage**


- Triggers now support API-driven notifications
- Create notification triggers based on specific events


‍


🤖 **AI**


- AI powered driver feedback report


‍


**🕹️ Control**


- Trigger notifications can now be directed to Zendesk & Pylon
- Provider and driver names remain visible when the details panel is closed
- Triggers have been enhanced to support the selection of multiple zones
- Improved UI is now live for the Report Incident page
- Define and add custom events through the Triggers system.
- Additional configuration options are now available for "Status Triggered Too Early" events


‍


🖥️ **Platform**


- Enhanced functionality added to the Update-job API
- GetZone API returns restrictions


‍
